div.l: He semed such / his wordes were so wise
Iustice he was ful ofte in assise
By patent and pleyn cōmmissioıı̄un
For his science / and for his high renoıı̄un
Of fees and robes hadde he manyon
So greet a purchasour was nowher non
Al was fe symple to hym in effecte
His purchasyng myghte not ben infecte
Nowher so besy a man . as he ther nas
And ȝit he semed / besier than he was
In termes hadde he caas and domes alle
That fro the tyme of kyng William were falle
Therto he cowde endite and make a thing .
Ther cowde no wight pynche at his writing
And eủery statute / cowde he pleyn by rote
He rode but homely / in a medle cote
Girt with a seint of silk with barres smale
Of his aray / telle I no lenger tale
A Frāmkeleyn was in his companie
White was his berde / as is the dayes eye
Of his complexcioıı̄un / he was sangwyne
Wel louede he by the morwe a sop in wyne
To lyuen in delite / eủere was his wone
For he was epicures owne sone
That heelde opinioıı̄un / that pleyn delite
Was verray felicite ꝑparfite
An housholder / and that a greet was he
Seint Iulian he was in his cuntre
His breed his ale / was alwey after oon
A better envyned man / was nowher noon
Withoute bake mete / was neủere his hous
Of fissh and flessh / and that so plenteuous
It snewed in his hous / of mete and drynke
Of alle deyntes / that men cowde thynke
After the sondry sesoıı̄uns of the ȝere
So chaunged he / his mete and his sopere
Ful many a fat partrich / hadde he in mewe
And many a breme / and many a pyke in stewe
Wo was his cook / but his sawce were
